Excellent! After Rg8+, all White king moves (Kh3, Kh5, Kh4) are followed by Rh7#. This is the move!

**Best move:** Rg8+

**Main line:** Rg8+ Kh3 (or Kh5, Kh4) Rh7#

**Motif:** discoveredAttack (the rook on g8 uncovers the e8–e1 line, but more importantly opens a back-rank mate pattern)

**Explanation (coaching note):**
When your opponent's king lacks escape squares, even checks can set up forced mate. Here, Rg8+ drives the king to safety but clears the 8th rank—now your remaining rook delivers unstoppable mate via Rh7#. The lesson: always scan for "quiet king moves" after checks; sometimes a follow-up threat is even stronger than immediate material.
